revisions.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Tight clothing-continuity correction to existing Soul Crystal painterly artwork. Recolor ONLY the brown short-sleeved T-shirt fabric to saturated medium royal BLUE matching the game's protagonist's blue T-shirt. Preserve silhouette, front view, folds, brushwork, highlights, dimensions and transparent background. Plain front; the neon surfer print is on its back and should NOT be visible from this front view. No other objects, labels or text. Preserve painterly style; no unrelated changes.

icons.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create the matching MUSIC OFF state of this exact painterly golden musical-note game icon. Preserve the two joined golden notes, their silhouette, scale, position, brushwork, rich warm gold and brown shading. Add one clearly legible diagonal muted dark-red bronze slash across the notes, with painterly beveled highlights in the same fantasy adventure style. Slash means muted music, readable at 48 pixels. No text, no frame, no new background. Output square PNG with genuinely transparent background, retaining transparency around and inside the note. This is a companion icon, not a redesign.
